assignments.why: New System One decision architecture trained on a Qwen backbone (decision models, open decision models), built to be order-invariant by construction (presentation sensitivity) with a separate null-coverage gate for none-fits cases (abstention and fallback).

Proposes DeRef, a reference-writing deriver that makes tool-argument judges more accurate (LLM and agent judges), after measuring the derivation gap across seven judges (judge and decision-model audits).

assignments.note: 2026-10 Judging the Judges Rubrics as Rewards
assignments.why: Rubric judges supply the GRPO reward and the paper studies what judge choice does to training (judges as reward signals), using judge confidence via logprob-weighted soft-Likert scores (LLM and agent judges) and ensembling five judges with disagreement filtering (social choice).
Shows a frozen causal LLM read via prefix-free option scoring is a Jev-style decision model and gives a KL-anchored fine-tuning recipe for open models.

assignments.note: 2026-10 Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
assignments.why: Measures (audit) that open typed decision models decide from option labels rather than definitions and flip under label swaps and negation (presentation sensitivity).

PFR test measuring how typed decision models use Other/Defer fallback options (audit, abstention and fallback) and how they flip under logically equivalent Union vs Complement fallback wordings (presentation sensitivity).
Builds an open bi-encoder System One decision model from a 30B multimodal decoder for small-option decisions and retrieval.
Fine-tunes MedGemma into a typed decision model (decision models, open decision models) whose main claim is far better calibrated confidence measured by ECE and reliability error (calibration).

LoRA-fine-tuned one-pass decision read (decision models, open decision models) designed to satisfy order invariance and Luce's axiom so option order and added options cannot steer it (presentation sensitivity).
Adds a typed CHOICE/NOUL/SCORE decision head to an audio LLM and trains it, an open audio decision model.
Diagnoses System One decision models choosing agent actions, measuring that most wrong actions follow correct reading of facts (failures inside agent loops).

assignments.note: 2026-10 Recalibrating Many Questions with Few Labels
assignments.why: Theory of per-question post-hoc recalibration under Brier risk with pooled isotonic fits (calibration), framed around recalibrating a probability-returning decision model like Jev (decision models).
Recipe for open decision models from letter-logit readout plus short LoRA (decision models, open decision models), where per-type temperature scaling is central to matching Jev (calibration).
Turns a looped LM into an open typed decision model (decision models, open decision models) that spends extra loops of compute with per-loop readouts and an exit gate (adaptive reasoning depth).
LoRA-adapts Kev's open single-pass candidate scorer to a 14-task security corpus, an open domain-specialised decision model.

assignments.note: 2026-10 Selective Reasoning for Typed Decision Models
assignments.why: Trained candidate-answer head on a frozen Qwen backbone (decision models, open decision models) with controllers deciding when to start partial chain of thought, read and stop (adaptive reasoning depth).

Open decision model family (decision models, open decision models) that reasons only below a 0.9 confidence gate (adaptive reasoning depth), trained with proper-score RLCD 2 rewards and policy-aware calibration maps (calibration).
Distils a compact open ModernBERT routing classifier over a fixed 60-category taxonomy from an NLI teacher, a recipe for an open System-1 style decision model positioned against Jev.

A one-pass typed decision actor in Doom (decision models) hands off to a slow VLM reasoner only when a confidence or progress gate opens, studying how to choose the actor and threshold (confidence-gated escalation, adaptive reasoning depth).

assignments.note: 2026-10 Typed Decision Models on Tabular Data
assignments.why: Measures typed decision models vs LLMs on table decisions (audit) with 21 information-preserving rewrites of option order, names and table layout that flip decisions (presentation sensitivity).
Benchmark auditing typed decision models on ECE against a null floor (calibration), accuracy across paraphrases and negations of the same rule (presentation sensitivity), and decision cost.

Open ModernBERT decision encoder packing many typed questions per pass (decision models, open decision models) with option-order and question-grouping invariance enforced by the attention mask (presentation sensitivity).
Replaces a video MLLM's generation head with a trained candidate-scoring head, an open System One decision model for video grounding and QA.

assignments.note: 2026-10 When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents
assignments.why: Empirical study of Jev as action selector in five agents, measuring cost savings and failures (failed recovery, premature completion) inside agent loops.
